description: This Java class defines a service layer for managing Employee entities, providing create, update, delete, get, and list operations using a repository.

classes.name: EmployeeService
classes.description: Service class providing CRUD operations for Employee entities, annotated as a Spring @Service component.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Employee based on EmployeeRequest and saves it to the repository.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Employee identified by id with data from EmployeeRequest.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an Employee identified by id from the repository.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an Employee by id, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of all Employees.
